notes:
# Blackline 0.15.129

* The message bar is no longer a plain text field: an emoji typed into it is drawn as a picture, on the line with the words, exactly where Discord puts it. A text field can only draw an emoji as a font glyph, and a glyph sits where the font says — which is why every attempt to nudge it failed.
* The four emoji at the top of a message's menu are the four you reacted with most recently, kept between runs.
* A message waiting to be sent shows a clock in the same corner the read tick uses, and reads like any other message.
